ace_draft: Lôn beudôh poh limong beungoh.
ind: Saya bangun jam lima pagi.
eng: I get up at five in the morning.

ace_draft: Lheueh beudôh, lôn seumayang subuh.
ind: Setelah bangun, saya salat subuh.
eng: After getting up, I pray the dawn prayer.

ace_draft: Ma teungoh taguen bu di dapu.
ind: Ibu sedang memasak nasi di dapur.
eng: Mother is cooking rice in the kitchen.

ace_draft: Ayah geujép kupi bak binteh rumoh.
ind: Ayah minum kopi di teras rumah.
eng: Father drinks coffee on the veranda.

ace_draft: Lôn jak manoe dilèe.
ind: Saya mandi dulu.
eng: I take a bath first.

ace_draft: Ie nyoe sijuek that beungoh nyoe.
ind: Air ini dingin sekali pagi ini.
eng: The water is very cold this morning.

ace_draft: Adoe lôn goh lom beudôh.
ind: Adik saya belum bangun.
eng: My younger sibling hasn't woken up yet.

ace_draft: Neubeudôh laju, ka beungoh!
ind: Bangun cepat, sudah pagi!
eng: Get up quickly, it's morning already!

ace_draft: Kamoe pajoh bu beungoh sajan-sajan.
ind: Kami sarapan bersama-sama.
eng: We have breakfast together.

ace_draft: Lôn galak that pajoh bu ngon eungkôt keumamah.
ind: Saya suka sekali makan nasi dengan ikan kayu.
eng: I really like rice with dried fish.

ace_draft: Peue na teh lom, Ma?
ind: Apakah masih ada teh, Bu?
eng: Is there any tea left, Mum?

ace_draft: Neusôk bajee sikula droeneuh.
ind: Pakai baju sekolahmu.
eng: Put on your school uniform.

ace_draft: Pat sipatu lôn? Hana lôn teupeue.
ind: Di mana sepatu saya? Saya tidak tahu.
eng: Where are my shoes? I don't know.

ace_draft: Uroe nyoe uroe Seunanyan.
ind: Hari ini hari Senin.
eng: Today is Monday.

ace_draft: Lôn ka télat, bagah-bagah.
ind: Saya sudah terlambat, cepat-cepat.
eng: I'm already late, hurry up.

ace_draft: Ka lôn jak, assalamu'alaikum.
ind: Saya pergi dulu, assalamu'alaikum.
eng: I'm off, peace be upon you.

ace_draft: Lôn jak u kantô ngon honda.
ind: Saya pergi ke kantor naik motor.
eng: I go to the office by motorbike.

ace_draft: Jalan nyoe padét that beungoh.
ind: Jalan ini macet sekali pagi hari.
eng: This road is very congested in the morning.

ace_draft: Neuék labi-labi atawa bécak?
ind: Anda naik labi-labi atau becak?
eng: Do you take the minibus or a rickshaw?

ace_draft: Padum ongkoih u Peunayong?
ind: Berapa ongkos ke Peunayong?
eng: How much is the fare to Peunayong?

ace_draft: Neupiyôh di keue meuseujid rayek.
ind: Berhenti di depan masjid raya.
eng: Stop in front of the grand mosque.

ace_draft: Uroe nyoe tutong that.
ind: Hari ini panas sekali.
eng: It's very hot today.

ace_draft: Siseun-siseun ujeuen teuka watee seupôt.
ind: Kadang-kadang hujan turun sore hari.
eng: Sometimes rain comes in the late afternoon.

ace_draft: Neuba payong, mungkén ujeuen.
ind: Bawa payung, mungkin hujan.
eng: Take an umbrella, it might rain.

ace_draft: Angen kong that di pante.
ind: Angin kencang sekali di pantai.
eng: The wind is very strong at the beach.

ace_draft: Laot teungoh teunang uroe nyoe.
ind: Laut sedang tenang hari ini.
eng: The sea is calm today.

ace_draft: Jalan u gampông ka rusak.
ind: Jalan ke kampung sudah rusak.
eng: The road to the village is damaged.

ace_draft: Lôn tinggai siat bak keude kupi.
ind: Saya singgah sebentar di warung kopi.
eng: I stop for a moment at the coffee shop.

ace_draft: Honda lôn abéh minyeuk.
ind: Motor saya kehabisan bensin.
eng: My motorbike is out of petrol.

ace_draft: Pat tempat isi minyeuk nyang tojeh?
ind: Di mana pom bensin yang terdekat?
eng: Where is the nearest petrol station?

ace_draft: Neujak hati-hati, jalan licin.
ind: Hati-hati, jalan licin.
eng: Go carefully, the road is slippery.

ace_draft: Lôn teuka di kantô poh lapan.
ind: Saya tiba di kantor jam delapan.
eng: I arrive at the office at eight.

ace_draft: Lôn keurija di kantô pemerintah.
ind: Saya bekerja di kantor pemerintah.
eng: I work in a government office.

ace_draft: Peue keurija droeneuh?
ind: Apa pekerjaan Anda?
eng: What is your job?

ace_draft: Jih guree di sikula dasar.
ind: Dia guru di sekolah dasar.
eng: She is a teacher at a primary school.

ace_draft: Aneuk miet jak sikula poh tujôh.
ind: Anak-anak pergi ke sekolah jam tujuh.
eng: The children go to school at seven.

ace_draft: Guree geupeurunoe basa Aceh bak kelas.
ind: Guru mengajar bahasa Aceh di kelas.
eng: The teacher teaches Acehnese in class.

ace_draft: Lôn teungoh meurunoe peugah basa Aceh.
ind: Saya sedang belajar berbicara bahasa Aceh.
eng: I am learning to speak Acehnese.

ace_draft: Neupeugah paih-paih siat.
ind: Bicara pelan-pelan sebentar.
eng: Please speak slowly.

ace_draft: Kiban tapeugah "computer" lam basa Aceh?
ind: Bagaimana mengatakan "computer" dalam bahasa Aceh?
eng: How do you say "computer" in Acehnese?

ace_draft: Lôn hana meuphôm, neuulang siat.
ind: Saya tidak mengerti, tolong ulangi.
eng: I don't understand, please repeat.

ace_draft: Kamoe meurapat poh siploh beungoh.
ind: Kami rapat jam sepuluh pagi.
eng: We have a meeting at ten in the morning.

ace_draft: Lôn tuléh surat keu kepala kantô.
ind: Saya menulis surat untuk kepala kantor.
eng: I write a letter to the office head.

ace_draft: Komputer lôn rusak, hana jeuet hidup.
ind: Komputer saya rusak, tidak bisa menyala.
eng: My computer is broken, it won't turn on.

ace_draft: Neutôlông lôn siat, bah?
ind: Tolong saya sebentar, boleh?
eng: Can you help me a moment?

ace_draft: Aneuk-aneuk nyan teungoh beuet Qur'an di meunasah.
ind: Anak-anak itu sedang mengaji di meunasah.
eng: Those children are reciting the Qur'an at the prayer hall.

ace_draft: Lôn hék that uroe nyoe, keurija le.
ind: Saya lelah sekali hari ini, kerja banyak.
eng: I'm very tired today, lots of work.

ace_draft: Pajan tanyoe woe?
ind: Kapan kita pulang?
eng: When do we go home?

ace_draft: Ma geujak u peukan bloe sayu.
ind: Ibu pergi ke pasar membeli sayur.
eng: Mother goes to the market to buy vegetables.

ace_draft: Padum yum eungkôt nyoe sikilo?
ind: Berapa harga ikan ini sekilo?
eng: How much is this fish per kilo?

ace_draft: Meuhai that, neupeukureueng bacut.
ind: Mahal sekali, kurangi sedikit.
eng: Too expensive, lower it a little.

ace_draft: Lôn bloe boh mamplam dua kilo.
ind: Saya membeli mangga dua kilo.
eng: I buy two kilos of mangoes.

ace_draft: Boh nyoe ka masak atawa goh lom?
ind: Buah ini sudah matang atau belum?
eng: Is this fruit ripe yet?

ace_draft: Neubri lôn sikai gulè kameng.
ind: Beri saya satu porsi gulai kambing.
eng: Give me one portion of goat curry.

ace_draft: Na pèng kecék? Lôn hana pèng kecék.
ind: Ada uang kecil? Saya tidak ada uang kecil.
eng: Do you have change? I have no small money.

ace_draft: Nyoe pèng jih, teurimong gaséh.
ind: Ini uangnya, terima kasih.
eng: Here's the money, thank you.

ace_draft: Ureueng meukat nyan ureueng Pidie.
ind: Pedagang itu orang Pidie.
eng: That seller is from Pidie.

ace_draft: Peukan nyoe rame that uroe Jumeu'at.
ind: Pasar ini ramai sekali hari Jumat.
eng: This market is very busy on Fridays.

ace_draft: Lôn tuwô bloe sira.
ind: Saya lupa membeli garam.
eng: I forgot to buy salt.

ace_draft: Pat jeuet tabloe bajee Aceh?
ind: Di mana bisa membeli baju Aceh?
eng: Where can I buy Acehnese clothes?

ace_draft: Kupi Aceh nyoe mangat that, lôn bloe sikilo.
ind: Kopi Aceh ini enak sekali, saya beli sekilo.
eng: This Acehnese coffee is delicious, I'll buy a kilo.

ace_draft: Toko nyan ka tutop uroe nyoe.
ind: Toko itu sudah tutup hari ini.
eng: That shop is closed today.

ace_draft: Lôn neuk bayeue ngon HP, jeuet?
ind: Saya mau bayar dengan HP, bisa?
eng: I want to pay by phone, is that OK?

ace_draft: Abéh pèng lôn lheueh bloe barang.
ind: Habis uang saya setelah belanja.
eng: My money is gone after shopping.

ace_draft: Ka cot uroe, jak tapajoh bu.
ind: Sudah siang, mari kita makan.
eng: It's midday, let's eat.

ace_draft: Lôn deuek that, goh lom pajoh bu beungoh.
ind: Saya lapar sekali, belum sarapan.
eng: I'm very hungry, I haven't had breakfast.

ace_draft: Peue tapajoh uroe nyoe?
ind: Kita makan apa hari ini?
eng: What are we eating today?

ace_draft: Mie Aceh nyoe keueung that.
ind: Mie Aceh ini pedas sekali.
eng: This Aceh noodle is very spicy.

ace_draft: Lôn bék keueung, bah?
ind: Saya jangan pedas, ya?
eng: Not spicy for me, OK?

ace_draft: Neubri ie putéh sigleh.
ind: Beri air putih segelas.
eng: A glass of water, please.

ace_draft: Kupi sanger saboh, hana sira.
ind: Kopi sanger satu, tanpa gula.
eng: One sanger coffee, no sugar.

ace_draft: Gulè pliek u nyoe peugöt ma lôn.
ind: Gulai pliek u ini buatan ibu saya.
eng: My mother made this pliek u curry.

ace_draft: Eungkôt nyoe barô, barô teuka nibak laot.
ind: Ikan ini segar, baru datang dari laut.
eng: This fish is fresh, just in from the sea.

ace_draft: Ka troe lôn, hana jeuet le.
ind: Saya sudah kenyang, tidak bisa lagi.
eng: I'm full, I can't eat any more.

ace_draft: Neupajoh lom bacut, bék malèe.
ind: Makan lagi sedikit, jangan malu.
eng: Eat a bit more, don't be shy.

ace_draft: Padum yum bu nyoe bandum?
ind: Berapa harga makanan ini semuanya?
eng: How much is all this food?

ace_draft: Boh u muda nyoe mangat watee tutong.
ind: Kelapa muda ini enak saat panas.
eng: Young coconut is nice when it's hot.

ace_draft: Lôn grah, neubri ie siat.
ind: Saya haus, beri air sebentar.
eng: I'm thirsty, some water please.

ace_draft: Timphan nyoe keu peunajoh uroe raya.
ind: Timphan ini untuk kue hari raya.
eng: These timphan are for the holiday.

ace_draft: Lheueh pajoh bu, tanyoe seumayang leuhö.
ind: Setelah makan, kita salat zuhur.
eng: After eating, we pray the noon prayer.

ace_draft: Seupôt nyoe lôn jak u rumoh rakan.
ind: Sore ini saya ke rumah teman.
eng: This afternoon I'm going to a friend's house.

ace_draft: Peue haba, ka trep hana meurumpok.
ind: Apa kabar, sudah lama tidak bertemu.
eng: How are you, long time no see.

ace_draft: Neutamông, neuduek dilèe.
ind: Masuk, silakan duduk dulu.
eng: Come in, please sit down.

ace_draft: Kamoe meututô sampoe magréb.
ind: Kami mengobrol sampai magrib.
eng: We chat until sunset.

ace_draft: Aneuk miet meu'en bhan bak lapangan.
ind: Anak-anak bermain bola di lapangan.
eng: The children play football on the field.

ace_draft: Ureueng chik geuduek bak jambo.
ind: Orang tua duduk di pondok.
eng: The elders sit in the hut.

ace_draft: Di blang, ureueng teungoh meugöe.
ind: Di sawah, orang sedang bertani.
eng: In the fields, people are farming.

ace_draft: Padé ka kuneng, singoh takôh.
ind: Padi sudah menguning, besok dipanen.
eng: The rice is yellow, tomorrow we harvest.

ace_draft: Kameng lôn gadoh, hana lôn teupeue pat.
ind: Kambing saya hilang, tidak tahu di mana.
eng: My goat is lost, I don't know where.

ace_draft: Ureueng gampông meugotong-royong peugöt jalan.
ind: Warga kampung gotong royong membuat jalan.
eng: The villagers work together to build the road.

ace_draft: Rumoh Aceh nyan ka tuha that.
ind: Rumah Aceh itu sudah sangat tua.
eng: That traditional house is very old.

ace_draft: Keuchik geupeugah haba bak meunasah.
ind: Kepala desa berbicara di meunasah.
eng: The village head speaks at the prayer hall.

ace_draft: Jak tajak u pante kalön mata uroe lôp.
ind: Ayo ke pantai melihat matahari terbenam.
eng: Let's go to the beach to watch the sunset.

ace_draft: Nyoe rakan lôn nibak Cina, jih neuk meurunoe basa Aceh.
ind: Ini teman saya dari Cina, dia mau belajar bahasa Aceh.
eng: This is my friend from China, she wants to learn Acehnese.

ace_draft: Neupeugah haba lam basa Aceh, bék lam basa Indonesia.
ind: Bicara dalam bahasa Aceh, jangan bahasa Indonesia.
eng: Speak in Acehnese, not Indonesian.

ace_draft: Aneuk muda jinôe jarang peugah basa Aceh.
ind: Anak muda sekarang jarang berbahasa Aceh.
eng: Young people rarely speak Acehnese now.

ace_draft: Ka magréb, jak taseumayang u meuseujid.
ind: Sudah magrib, ayo salat ke masjid.
eng: It's sunset, let's go pray at the mosque.

ace_draft: Azan ka deungo nibak meunasah.
ind: Azan sudah terdengar dari meunasah.
eng: The call to prayer can be heard from the prayer hall.

ace_draft: Lheueh seumayang, kamoe pajoh bu malam.
ind: Setelah salat, kami makan malam.
eng: After prayer, we have dinner.

ace_draft: Ayah geukalön berita bak TV.
ind: Ayah menonton berita di TV.
eng: Father watches the news on TV.

ace_draft: Ma geupeurunoe adoe beuet.
ind: Ibu mengajar adik mengaji.
eng: Mother teaches my little sibling to recite.

ace_draft: Nek geupeugah haba jameun keu aneuk cucô.
ind: Nenek bercerita masa lalu kepada cucu.
eng: Grandmother tells stories of old times to the grandchildren.

ace_draft: Padum droe aneuk droeneuh?
ind: Berapa anak Anda?
eng: How many children do you have?

ace_draft: Lôn na lhèe droe aneuk, dua agam saboh inong.
ind: Saya punya tiga anak, dua laki-laki satu perempuan.
eng: I have three children, two boys and one girl.

ace_draft: Aduen lôn keurija di Medan.
ind: Kakak laki-laki saya bekerja di Medan.
eng: My older brother works in Medan.

ace_draft: Cutda ka meukawén thon barôe.
ind: Kakak perempuan sudah menikah tahun lalu.
eng: My older sister got married last year.

ace_draft: Keuluarga kamoe rame, saboh rumoh siploh droe.
ind: Keluarga kami ramai, satu rumah sepuluh orang.
eng: Our family is big, ten people in one house.

ace_draft: Aneuk lôn ka jeuet peugah basa Aceh bacut-bacut.
ind: Anak saya sudah bisa bahasa Aceh sedikit-sedikit.
eng: My child can speak a little Acehnese now.

ace_draft: Neujaga keséhatan, bék sakét.
ind: Jaga kesehatan, jangan sakit.
eng: Take care of your health, don't get sick.

ace_draft: Nek lôn sakét, kamoe ba u rumoh sakét.
ind: Nenek saya sakit, kami bawa ke rumah sakit.
eng: My grandmother is ill, we take her to the hospital.

ace_draft: Alhamdulillah, jih ka puléh.
ind: Alhamdulillah, dia sudah sembuh.
eng: Thank God, she has recovered.

ace_draft: Malam nyoe na kenduri di rumoh teungku.
ind: Malam ini ada kenduri di rumah teungku.
eng: Tonight there is a feast at the teungku's house.

ace_draft: Ka malam, aneuk miet ka éh.
ind: Sudah malam, anak-anak sudah tidur.
eng: It's night, the children are asleep.

ace_draft: Lôn baca buku siat sigohôm éh.
ind: Saya membaca buku sebentar sebelum tidur.
eng: I read a book a while before sleeping.

ace_draft: Buleuen teurang that malam nyoe.
ind: Bulan terang sekali malam ini.
eng: The moon is very bright tonight.

ace_draft: Lôn teuingat keu gampông.
ind: Saya rindu kampung.
eng: I miss my village.

ace_draft: Lôn seunang that meurumpok ngon droeneuh.
ind: Saya senang sekali bertemu dengan Anda.
eng: I'm very happy to meet you.

ace_draft: Pakon droeneuh seudih?
ind: Kenapa Anda sedih?
eng: Why are you sad?

ace_draft: Hana peue, lôn hék mantong.
ind: Tidak apa-apa, saya hanya lelah.
eng: Nothing, I'm just tired.

ace_draft: Bék neutakôt, lôn na di sinoe.
ind: Jangan takut, saya ada di sini.
eng: Don't be afraid, I'm here.

ace_draft: Peue nyang neuk neupeugah?
ind: Apa yang mau Anda katakan?
eng: What do you want to say?

ace_draft: Soe nyang teuka barôe malam?
ind: Siapa yang datang tadi malam?
eng: Who came last night?

ace_draft: Pajan droeneuh woe u Cina?
ind: Kapan Anda pulang ke Cina?
eng: When do you go back to China?

ace_draft: Kiban cara tapeugah "I love you" lam basa Aceh?
ind: Bagaimana cara mengatakan "I love you" dalam bahasa Aceh?
eng: How do you say "I love you" in Acehnese?

ace_draft: Basa Aceh nyoe peunting, bék tapeugadoh.
ind: Bahasa Aceh ini penting, jangan kita hilangkan.
eng: Acehnese matters, let's not lose it.

ace_draft: Tanyoe meuséti jaga basa droe teuh.
ind: Kita harus menjaga bahasa kita sendiri.
eng: We must protect our own language.

ace_draft: Singoh tameurumpok lom, insya Allah.
ind: Besok kita bertemu lagi, insya Allah.
eng: We'll meet again tomorrow, God willing.

ace_draft: Malam gét, neuéh beu mangat.
ind: Selamat malam, tidur nyenyak.
eng: Good night, sleep well.

setting: At a coffee shop. A = visitor, B = older male seller (polite register).
speaker: A
ace_draft: Assalamu'alaikum, Bang. Na kupi sanger?
ind: Assalamu'alaikum, Bang. Ada kopi sanger?
eng: Peace be upon you. Do you have sanger coffee?

setting: At a coffee shop. A = visitor, B = older male seller (polite register).
speaker: B
ace_draft: Wa'alaikumsalam. Na, na. Neuduek dilèe. Sanger sijuek atawa seu'uem?
ind: Ada, ada. Silakan duduk dulu. Sanger dingin atau panas?
eng: Yes, yes. Please sit. Iced or hot sanger?

setting: At a coffee shop. A = visitor, B = older male seller (polite register).
speaker: A
ace_draft: Nyang seu'uem saboh, Bang. Ngon kuéh peue nyang na?
ind: Yang panas satu, Bang. Kuenya apa saja yang ada?
eng: One hot, please. What cakes do you have?

setting: At a coffee shop. A = visitor, B = older male seller (polite register).
speaker: B
ace_draft: Na timphan, na pulot, na kuéh bhoi. Nyoe barô peugöt beungoh nyoe.
ind: Ada timphan, pulut, kue bhoi. Ini baru dibuat pagi tadi.
eng: Timphan, sticky rice, bhoi cake. Made fresh this morning.

setting: At a coffee shop. A = visitor, B = older male seller (polite register).
speaker: A
ace_draft: Timphan dua boh beh. Bang, droeneuh ureueng pat asai?
ind: Timphan dua, ya. Bang, Anda asalnya dari mana?
eng: Two timphan then. Where are you from originally?

setting: At a coffee shop. A = visitor, B = older male seller (polite register).
speaker: B
ace_draft: Lôn ureueng Pidie, ka dua ploh thôn meukat di Banda. Droeneuh nibak pat? Hana lagée ureueng Aceh.
ind: Saya orang Pidie, sudah dua puluh tahun berjualan di Banda. Anda dari mana? Tidak seperti orang Aceh.
eng: I'm from Pidie, twenty years selling here. And you? You don't look Acehnese.

setting: At a coffee shop. A = visitor, B = older male seller (polite register).
speaker: A
ace_draft: Lôn nibak Cina, Bang. Lôn teungoh meurunoe basa Aceh, teuma goh lom lanca.
ind: Saya dari Cina, Bang. Sedang belajar bahasa Aceh, tapi belum lancar.
eng: I'm from China. I'm learning Acehnese, not fluent yet.

setting: At a coffee shop. A = visitor, B = older male seller (polite register).
speaker: B
ace_draft: Hai, ka jeuet neupeugah lagèe nyan, ka gét that! Neujak keunoe tiep uroe, lôn peurunoe droeneuh. Kupi gratis.
ind: Wah, sudah bisa bicara begitu, sudah bagus sekali! Datang ke sini tiap hari, saya ajari. Kopinya gratis.
eng: You can already speak like that, excellent! Come every day, I'll teach you. Coffee's free.

setting: Asking the way. A = visitor, B = young woman at a roadside stall.
speaker: A
ace_draft: Meu'ah, Cutkak. Pat jalan u Meuseujid Raya?
ind: Maaf, Kak. Ke mana jalan ke Masjid Raya?
eng: Excuse me, miss. Which way to the Grand Mosque?

setting: Asking the way. A = visitor, B = young woman at a roadside stall.
speaker: B
ace_draft: Meuseujid Raya? Neujak teupat dilèe, lheueh nyan belôk u uneun bak simpang keu dua.
ind: Masjid Raya? Lurus dulu, lalu belok kanan di simpang kedua.
eng: Go straight, then turn right at the second junction.

setting: Asking the way. A = visitor, B = young woman at a roadside stall.
speaker: A
ace_draft: Jiôh lom nibak sinoe?
ind: Masih jauh dari sini?
eng: Is it still far from here?

setting: Asking the way. A = visitor, B = young woman at a roadside stall.
speaker: B
ace_draft: Hana jiôh, kira-kira siploh minet meujak kaki. Meunyo ék bécak, lhèe minet.
ind: Tidak jauh, sekitar sepuluh menit jalan kaki. Kalau naik becak, tiga menit.
eng: Not far, about ten minutes on foot. By rickshaw, three.

setting: Asking the way. A = visitor, B = young woman at a roadside stall.
speaker: A
ace_draft: Lôn jak kaki mantong. Padum poh jinôe? Neuk lôn seumayang asa di sinan.
ind: Saya jalan kaki saja. Jam berapa sekarang? Saya mau salat asar di sana.
eng: I'll walk. What time is it? I want to pray asr there.

setting: Asking the way. A = visitor, B = young woman at a roadside stall.
speaker: B
ace_draft: Poh lhèe seutengoh. Mantong na watee, azan asa poh peuet kureueng.
ind: Jam setengah empat. Masih ada waktu, azan asar jam empat kurang.
eng: Half past three. Still time, the call is a bit before four.

setting: Asking the way. A = visitor, B = young woman at a roadside stall.
speaker: A
ace_draft: Alhamdulillah. Teurimong gaséh beu rayek, Cutkak.
ind: Alhamdulillah. Terima kasih banyak, Kak.
eng: Thank God. Thank you very much.

setting: Asking the way. A = visitor, B = young woman at a roadside stall.
speaker: B
ace_draft: Hana peue. Neujak hati-hati, uroe tutong, neuba ie.
ind: Sama-sama. Hati-hati, hari panas, bawa air.
eng: You're welcome. Take care, it's hot, bring water.

setting: Meeting a friend's grandmother. A = visitor (highest politeness), B = grandmother (familiar forms back).
speaker: A
ace_draft: Assalamu'alaikum, Nek. Lôn rakan Fadli, nibak Cina.
ind: Assalamu'alaikum, Nek. Saya teman Fadli, dari Cina.
eng: Peace be upon you, Grandmother. I'm Fadli's friend, from China.

setting: Meeting a friend's grandmother. A = visitor (highest politeness), B = grandmother (familiar forms back).
speaker: B
ace_draft: Wa'alaikumsalam, aneuk. Tamông, tamông, duek keunoe dék nek. Ka pajoh bu?
ind: Masuk, masuk, duduk sini dekat nenek. Sudah makan?
eng: Come in, sit here by me, child. Have you eaten?

setting: Meeting a friend's grandmother. A = visitor (highest politeness), B = grandmother (familiar forms back).
speaker: A
ace_draft: Ka, Nek, barô pajoh di keude. Nek séhat?
ind: Sudah, Nek, baru makan di warung. Nenek sehat?
eng: Yes, I just ate at a stall. Are you well, Grandmother?

setting: Meeting a friend's grandmother. A = visitor (highest politeness), B = grandmother (familiar forms back).
speaker: B
ace_draft: Alhamdulillah, séhat, teuma tuot ka sakét meunyo ujeuen. Umu nek ka lapan ploh.
ind: Alhamdulillah, sehat, tapi lutut sakit kalau hujan. Umur nenek sudah delapan puluh.
eng: Thank God, well, but my knees hurt when it rains. I'm eighty.

setting: Meeting a friend's grandmother. A = visitor (highest politeness), B = grandmother (familiar forms back).
speaker: A
ace_draft: Lapan ploh! Nek mantong kong that. Fadli peugah Nek jeuet peugah hikayat.
ind: Delapan puluh! Nenek masih kuat sekali. Fadli bilang Nenek bisa bercerita hikayat.
eng: Eighty! You're still so strong. Fadli says you can recite hikayat.

setting: Meeting a friend's grandmother. A = visitor (highest politeness), B = grandmother (familiar forms back).
speaker: B
ace_draft: Hai, jameun nek sabe peugah hikayat keu aneuk-aneuk. Jinôe hana le nyang galak deungö, bandum kalön HP.
ind: Dulu nenek selalu bercerita hikayat untuk anak-anak. Sekarang tidak ada lagi yang mau dengar, semua lihat HP.
eng: I used to tell hikayat to the children. Now nobody wants to listen, they all look at phones.

setting: Meeting a friend's grandmother. A = visitor (highest politeness), B = grandmother (familiar forms back).
speaker: A
ace_draft: Lôn galak deungö, Nek. Jeuet lôn rekam ngon HP lôn, bah bék gadoh?
ind: Saya mau dengar, Nek. Boleh saya rekam dengan HP, supaya tidak hilang?
eng: I want to listen. May I record it on my phone, so it isn't lost?

setting: Meeting a friend's grandmother. A = visitor (highest politeness), B = grandmother (familiar forms back).
speaker: B
ace_draft: Bah, bah, rekam laju. Nek peugah Hikayat Malem Diwa. Duek gét-gét, nyoe panyang.
ind: Boleh, boleh, rekam saja. Nenek ceritakan Hikayat Malem Diwa. Duduk baik-baik, ini panjang.
eng: Yes, yes, record it. I'll tell the Hikayat Malem Diwa. Sit properly, it's long.

setting: Planning the language project. A = visitor, B = Acehnese friend of the same age (familiar register: kah, kèe).
speaker: A
ace_draft: Fadli, kiban meunyo tanyoe peugöt data basa Aceh keu AI?
ind: Fadli, bagaimana kalau kita buat data bahasa Aceh untuk AI?
eng: Fadli, what if we build Acehnese data for AI?

setting: Planning the language project. A = visitor, B = Acehnese friend of the same age (familiar register: kah, kèe).
speaker: B
ace_draft: Data peue? Lagèe kamus? Kamus ka na, nibak Balai Bahasa.
ind: Data apa? Seperti kamus? Kamus sudah ada, dari Balai Bahasa.
eng: What data? Like a dictionary? There's one already, from Balai Bahasa.

setting: Planning the language project. A = visitor, B = Acehnese friend of the same age (familiar register: kah, kèe).
speaker: A
ace_draft: Kön kamus mantong. Su ureueng. Tanyoe rekam ureueng peugah haba, lheueh nyan tatuléh peue nyang geupeugah.
ind: Bukan hanya kamus. Suara orang. Kita rekam orang bicara, lalu kita tulis apa yang mereka katakan.
eng: Not just a dictionary. Voices. We record people talking, then write down what they said.

setting: Planning the language project. A = visitor, B = Acehnese friend of the same age (familiar register: kah, kèe).
speaker: B
ace_draft: Oh, lagèe nyan. Teuma ureueng Aceh peugah hana saban, ureueng Pidie ngon ureueng Barat laen dialek.
ind: Oh, begitu. Tapi orang Aceh bicaranya tidak sama, orang Pidie dan orang Barat lain dialek.
eng: Oh, like that. But Acehnese don't all speak the same; Pidie and the west coast have different dialects.

setting: Planning the language project. A = visitor, B = Acehnese friend of the same age (familiar register: kah, kèe).
speaker: A
ace_draft: Nyan keuh nyang gét! Tanyoe rekam bandum dialek. Nek kah, rakan kah di Meulaboh, bandum.
ind: Itulah yang bagus! Kita rekam semua dialek. Nenekmu, temanmu di Meulaboh, semuanya.
eng: That's exactly what's good! We record every dialect. Your grandmother, your friend in Meulaboh, everyone.

setting: Planning the language project. A = visitor, B = Acehnese friend of the same age (familiar register: kah, kèe).
speaker: B
ace_draft: Padum le nyang peureulee? Siuroe dua uroe ka abéh?
ind: Berapa banyak yang perlu? Satu dua hari sudah selesai?
eng: How much do we need? Done in a day or two?

setting: Planning the language project. A = visitor, B = Acehnese friend of the same age (familiar register: kah, kèe).
speaker: A
ace_draft: Hana. Minimai limong ploh droe ureueng, tiep droe seutengoh jeum. Nyan kira-kira dua ploh limong jeum su.
ind: Tidak. Minimal lima puluh orang, tiap orang setengah jam. Itu sekitar dua puluh lima jam suara.
eng: No. At least fifty people, half an hour each. About twenty-five hours of audio.

setting: Planning the language project. A = visitor, B = Acehnese friend of the same age (familiar register: kah, kèe).
speaker: B
ace_draft: Hai, le that! Teuma jeuet, kèe hoi rakan-rakan di kampus. Singoh tamulai, bak keude kupi Bang Pidie.
ind: Wah, banyak sekali! Tapi bisa, aku ajak teman-teman di kampus. Besok kita mulai, di warung kopi Bang Pidie.
eng: Wow, that's a lot! But doable, I'll call friends from campus. Tomorrow we start, at Bang Pidie's coffee shop.

title: Beungoh sampoe cot uroe (morning to midday)
ace_draft: Tiep uroe, lôn beudôh poh limong beungoh watee azan subuh ka deungo nibak meunasah gampông. Lôn beudôh nibak teumpat éh, lôn jak cok ie seumayang, lheueh nyan lôn seumayang subuh sajan ngon ayah di rumoh. Ma lôn ka lheueh beudôh dilèe nibak kamoe bandum, geuteungoh taguen ie keu kupi ngon teh lam dapu. Bee kupi Aceh nyang mangat nyan ka meusampôh lam rumoh, dan lôn teupeue uroe nyoe ka geumulai. Lheueh seumayang, lôn duek siat bak binteh rumoh ngon ayah, kamoe jép kupi ngon peugah haba keu peue nyang neuk tapeubuet uroe nyoe. Ayah geupeugah bahwa singoh na kenduri di rumoh teungku, dan geuyue lôn tulông peugöt teumpat duek keu ureueng nyang teuka. Lheueh nyan lôn jak manoe. Ie lam bak ie sijuëk that beungoh nyoe sabab barôe malam ujeuen raya sampoe subuh. Lheueh manoe, lôn sôk bajee keurija, lôn sugo ôk, dan lôn jak u dapu pajoh bu beungoh. Ma geupeugöt bu ngon eungkôt keumamah, gulè boh labu, ngon sambai. Adoe lôn nyang paléng tuha mantong teungeut, ma geuhoi jih padum goe lom barô jibeudôh. Jih ka kelas nam sikula dasar, jiteungoh meurunoe keu ujian. Kamoe pajoh bu sajan-sajan, peugah haba, ngon khem-khem meudeungö haba adoe nyang jipeugah keu rakan jih di sikula. Poh tujôh kureueng, lôn ék honda lôn jak u kantô. Jalan nibak gampông kamoe u kuta Banda Aceh paneuk mantong, kira-kira lhèe blah kilo, teuma watee beungoh jalan nyan padét that sabab le ureueng jak keurija ngon aneuk sikula. Lôn liwat keue Meuseujid Raya Baiturrahman, lôn kalön ureueng le teungoh jak seumayang dhuha ngon ureueng meukat teungoh buka keude. Mata uroe ka teubiet, langet biru, hana awan, lôn teupeue uroe nyoe tutong that. Lôn piyôh siat bak keude kupi dék Peunayong, lôn bloe kupi sanger saboh ngon kuéh timphan dua boh keu peunajoh watee cot uroe. Ureueng nyang meukat di sinan ureueng Pidie, geupeugah basa Aceh ngon lôn, dan lôn seunang that sabab jarang that jinôe ureueng di kuta peugah basa Aceh ngon ureueng nyang hana geuturi. Lôn teuka di kantô poh lapan pah. Kantô kamoe hana rayek, na kira-kira dua ploh droe ureueng keurija di sinan. Beungoh nyoe kamoe na rapat ngon kepala kantô keu program barô: peugöt kamus basa Aceh lam HP keu aneuk sikula. Lôn galak that program nyoe, sabab lôn kalön aneuk muda jinôe le nyang hana jeuet le peugah basa Aceh beutôi, awaknyan peugah basa Indonesia mantong, bahkan ngon ma ngon ayah droe jih. Lheueh rapat, lôn duek bak meja lôn, lôn tuléh surat, lôn baca laporan, lôn balaih email. Komputer lôn padum goe hana jeuet hidup, lôn hoi rakan lôn nyang teupeue komputer, jih tulông lôn sampoe jeuet lom. Watee poh dua blah, azan leuhö ka deungo, kamoe bandum jak seumayang u meuseujid dék kantô. Lheueh seumayang, kamoe jak pajoh bu cot uroe sajan-sajan bak warong dék jalan. Lôn pajoh mie Aceh keueung ngon ie boh u muda, mangat that, teuma keueung that cit sampoe lôn meu'ie mata.
eng_summary: I wake at five to the dawn call to prayer, pray with my father, and my mother is already making coffee. Father mentions tomorrow's feast at the teungku's house. Cold bath after last night's rain, breakfast of rice with dried fish and pumpkin curry; my youngest sibling oversleeps before his exams. I ride to the office through heavy traffic past the Grand Mosque, stop for sanger coffee and timphan cakes from a Pidie seller who speaks Acehnese with me, which is rare in town now. At work we plan a phone dictionary app for schoolchildren because young people are losing the language; my computer fails and a colleague fixes it. Noon prayer, then spicy Aceh noodles with young coconut water.

title: Seupôt sampoe malam (afternoon to night)
ace_draft: Seupôt, poh peuet, lôn woe nibak kantô. Jalan ka padét lom, teuma lôn hana meucicah, lôn jak paih-paih sabab jalan dék gampông kamoe ka rusak padum boh teumpat lheueh ujeuen barôe malam. Watee lôn teuka di rumoh, ma teungoh duek bak binteh ngon nek, awak geuteungoh peugöt kuéh keu kenduri singoh. Nek lôn ka tuha, umu geuh lapan ploh thôn, teuma geumantong kong, geumantong jeuet peugöt kuéh ngon geumantong jeuet peugah hikayat nyang panyang-panyang. Lôn duek dék geuh, lôn deungö geupeugah haba jameun, watee gampông kamoe mantong hana listrik, watee ureueng jak u blang ngon leumo, watee ie beuna thôn dua ribee peuet nyang ka peugadoh le that ureueng. Nek geupeugah bandum lam basa Aceh nyang gét, basa nyang jinôe jarang that lôn deungö nibak aneuk muda. Lôn pikée, meunyo nek ka hana le, soe lom nyang jeuet peugah hikayat lagée nyan? Nyan keuh sabab lôn ngon rakan-rakan lôn neuk peugöt program keu peulestari basa Aceh ngon teknologi: kamoe neuk rekam su ureueng chik, kamoe neuk tuléh haba awak geuh, kamoe neuk peugöt kamus ngon aplikasi nyang jeuet jipeunguy le aneuk miet. Lheueh nyan lôn jak u lapangan gampông, aneuk miet teungoh meu'en bhan, adoe lôn na cit di sinan. Lôn kalön awaknyan meu'en sampoe mata uroe lôp, langet jeuet mirah ngon kuneng, angen sijuëk nibak laot teuka paih-paih. Ureueng chik geuduek bak jambo dék lapangan, geujép kupi ngon geupeugah haba keu padé nyang ka kuneng di blang, singoh atawa lusa awak geuh neuk takôh padé sajan-sajan. Watee azan magréb deungo, kamoe bandum woe u rumoh, manoe, sôk bajee gét, lheueh nyan jak seumayang u meunasah. Meunasah gampông kamoe ubit teuma peunoh ureueng tiep malam. Lheueh seumayang magréb, aneuk miet beuet Qur'an ngon teungku sampoe isya, su awaknyan deungo sampoe u jalan. Lheueh isya, kamoe pajoh bu malam sajan-sajan di rumoh: bu, gulè pliek u, eungkôt masak mirah, ngon boh timon. Ayah geukalön berita bak TV, ma ngon nek geupeugah haba lam dapu, adoe lôn jipeugöt tugaih sikula bak meja. Lôn duek bak binteh, lôn kalön buleuen nyang teurang that malam nyoe, lôn pikée keu rakan lôn nibak Cina nyang teuka u Aceh seumingu nyoe. Jih neuk meurunoe basa Aceh, jih tanyong keu lôn tiep uroe: peue nan nyoe lam basa Aceh, kiban tapeugah nyan, pakon ureueng Aceh peugah meunan. Lôn seunang that na ureueng nibak jiôh nyang peduli keu basa kamoe, sabab siseun-siseun kamoe keudroe tuwô padum peunting basa nyoe. Basa Aceh kön mantong alat keu peugah haba; basa nyoe teumpat keu hikayat nek, keu syair ureueng jameun, keu doa ma watee aneuk sakét, keu khem rakan bak keude kupi. Meunyo basa nyoe gadoh, gadoh cit sibagian nibak droe tanyoe. Nyan keuh sabab lôn tuléh haba uroe nyoe lam basa Aceh, bah pih na nyang salah, bah pih na kata nyang hana beutôi, sabab nibak nyang salah nyan tanyoe jeuet meurunoe sajan-sajan. Singoh tanyoe meurumpok lom di kenduri, lôn neuk tanyong keu ureueng chik kiban cara peugah nyang beutôi. Ka malam, mata lôn ka seu'uem, lôn jak éh. Malam gét, insya Allah singoh tanyoe meurumpok lom.
eng_summary: I ride home slowly on a rain-damaged road. Mother and my eighty-year-old grandmother are making cakes for the feast; grandmother tells stories of the village before electricity, of ploughing with cattle, of the 2004 tsunami, all in rich Acehnese that young people no longer speak. I wonder who will tell these stories when she is gone, which is why my friends and I want to record elders and build dictionaries and apps. Children play football until the red-and-yellow sunset; elders in the hut plan the rice harvest. Sunset prayer at the small, full meunasah; children recite Qur'an until night prayer. Dinner of pliek u curry and red-cooked fish. On the veranda under a bright moon I think of my friend from China who came to learn Acehnese and asks questions every day. The language is not just a tool but holds grandmother's tales, old poetry, a mother's prayers and friends' laughter; if it is lost, part of us is lost. So I wrote today in Acehnese, mistakes and all, because we learn together from them. Tomorrow at the feast I will ask the elders how to say it properly. Good night.
